critique.evidence: The screen strongly advances the intent-integrity defense narrative through adaptive red-team mutations, training-fold-only results, surviving attack families, holdout/regression gates, guarded promotion, and an explicit “live unchanged” boundary. Payment-fraud relevance is suggested by known-payee reuse, velocity, fanout, graph signals, and evasion fitness. However, the headline 0% result is only a training replay, while fresh-row regression is referenced but not visibly quantified. The screen also lacks an explicit Mastercard/payment-rail scenario and operational impact such as fraud loss prevented, false-positive cost, approval-rate effect, or decision latency.
critique.fix: Show a quantified fresh-row/holdout result beside the training curve, including survivor rate, false positives, approval impact, and latency. Frame the arena around a concrete Mastercard transaction or account-to-account fraud workflow, and trace one mutation through detection, regression gates, human approval, and safe deployment without updating the live model.
